usedFor: Razorpay holds refunds and subscriptions, and viaSocket utilities starts another workflow with “Flow in Flow” or waits with “Pause Workflow”.

bestTemplate.name: “A New Refund Is Created” in Razorpay, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A refund can start a separate workflow that handles it, and the action runs another workflow from the current one.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” needs the child workflow's flowid, so have it ready before “A New Refund Is Created” runs.
